mapper.sql: ua.id, ua.question_id, q.question_type, q.source_text, q.level, q.difficulty, ua.answer_text, ua.answer_status, ua.grammar_vocabulary_score, ua.natural_fluency_score, ua.scenario_adaptation_score, ua.information_completeness_score, ua.total_score, ua.ai_revised_text as revised_text, ua.created_at, ua.updated_at

ua.id, ua.question_id, q.question_type, q.source_text, q.context_text, q.level, q.difficulty, q.grammar_point, ua.answer_text, ua.answer_status, ua.grammar_vocabulary_score, ua.natural_fluency_score, ua.scenario_adaptation_score, ua.information_completeness_score, ua.total_score, ua.ai_overall_comment as overall_comment, ua.ai_revised_text as revised_text, ua.created_at, ua.updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into user_answers ( user_id, question_id, answer_text, answer_status, deleted, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{questionId}, #{answerText}, #{answerStatus}, #{deleted}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )

insert into user_answers ( user_id, question_id, answer_text, answer_status, grammar_vocabulary_score, natural_fluency_score, scenario_adaptation_score, information_completeness_score, total_score, ai_overall_comment, ai_revised_text, deleted, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{userId}, null, #{answerText}, 'REVIEWED', #{grammarVocabularyScore}, #{naturalFluencyScore}, #{scenarioAdaptationScore}, #{informationCompletenessScore}, #{totalScore}, #{aiOverallComment}, #{aiRevisedText}, #{deleted}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update user_answers set answer_status = 'REVIEWED', grammar_vocabulary_score = #{grammarVocabularyScore}, natural_fluency_score = #{naturalFluencyScore}, scenario_adaptation_score = #{scenarioAdaptationScore}, information_completeness_score = #{informationCompletenessScore}, total_score = #{totalScore}, ai_overall_comment = #{aiOverallComment}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id} and deleted = false
mapper.select: select count(1) from user_answers ua left join questions q on q.id = ua.question_id

select
from user_answers ua left join questions q on q.id = ua.question_id where ua.id = #{id} and ua.user_id = #{userId} and ua.deleted = false and (ua.question_id is null or q.deleted = false)

select id, user_id, question_id, answer_text, answer_status, grammar_vocabulary_score, natural_fluency_score, scenario_adaptation_score, information_completeness_score, total_score, ai_overall_comment, ai_revised_text, deleted, created_at, updated_at from user_answers where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and deleted = false
